{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter for completed orders AND exclude QA orders in a single step, avoiding index misalignment
completed_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Final validation
assert len(completed_clean) == 815 - 6, "Expected 809 completed orders after removing 6 QA"
assert (completed_clean['status'] == 'completed').all(), "Non-completed orders included in completed_clean"
assert (completed_clean['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99).all(), "QA orders still present in completed_clean"

# Print final result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding 6 QA orders): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
